layers.description: Local preservation context layer from Park Ridge public GIS when available.
layers.attribution: City of Park Ridge GIS when configured.
layers.historicalQuestion: Which properties have local historic landmark context?

layers.name: Park Ridge 100 Year-Old Homes
layers.description: Local context layer for 100-year-old homes where public GIS access is available.
layers.attribution: City of Park Ridge GIS when configured.
layers.historicalQuestion: Which structures are recognized locally as 100-year-old homes?
layers.notes: This is preservation/context evidence, not subdivision evidence.

layers.name: Historic Character Candidates
layers.description: Assessor-derived 100-year-home candidate parcels, useful for seeing older-house pockets and preservation context.
layers.sourceName: Cook County Assessor parcel year-built fields
layers.attribution: Cook County Assessor / Cook County Open Data; candidate classification generated by this project.
layers.historicalQuestion: Where are the oldest surviving houses likely concentrated?
layers.notes: Derived from assessor year_built as of 2026. This is not an official City of Park Ridge landmark or 100-year-home designation.

layers.name: Building Footprints
layers.description: Cook County building footprint polygons clipped to Park Ridge for seeing actual structure shapes.
layers.attribution: Cook County GIS.
layers.historicalQuestion: How do building shapes sit on each lot, and where are garages, additions, and large footprints visible?
layers.notes: Downloaded from the Cook County building footprint service and clipped to Park Ridge. The source service includes capture-year and height-style fields where available.

layers.name: Lot Coverage
layers.description: Parcel heat layer estimating how much of each lot is covered by building footprints.
layers.sourceName: Computed from Cook County building footprints and Park Ridge parcels
layers.attribution: Cook County GIS / Cook County Open Data; lot-coverage estimates generated by this project.
layers.historicalQuestion: Which lots are lightly built, heavily built, or physically maxed out?
layers.notes: Computed by assigning building footprint representative points to parcels. It is a planning insight layer, not a zoning determination.

layers.name: PLSS Sections
layers.description: Public Land Survey System context for township/section geography.
layers.sourceName: Cook County GIS / PLSS reference data
layers.attribution: Cook County GIS or authoritative PLSS source when configured.
layers.historicalQuestion: What survey framework underlies parcel geography?

layers.name: Parcel Changes 2000-2021
layers.description: Computed parcel change candidates from real Cook County 2000 and 2021 Park Ridge parcel layers.
layers.sourceName: Computed from Cook County 2000Parcels and ccgisdata - Parcel 2021
layers.attribution: Cook County GIS / Cook County Open Data; candidate classification generated by this project.
layers.historicalQuestion: Which boundary changes are candidates for further verification?
layers.notes: Change types are spatial candidates and need verification against recorded plats, tax records, and survey evidence.

layers.name: Sanborn Map Sheets
layers.description: Future georeferenced map sheets for historic block-level building and land-use evidence.
layers.attribution: Sanborn source and license required when obtained.
layers.historicalQuestion: What building footprints, materials, uses, and addresses are documented on historic sheets?
layers.notes: Access and licensing vary; do not assume open API access.
